Back in January 2025, right after John Ratcliffe was appointed CIA director, Sergey Naryshkin said he was ready to meet his American counterpart if Washington showed interest. In March, the two intelligence chiefs spoke by phone for the first time, discussing cooperation between the agencies and crisis-management coordination, and agreeing to keep in regular contact to reduce Moscow-Washington confrontation.

In April, Naryshkin mentioned another call with Ratcliffe and suggested a personal meeting could happen soon. By summer he said the two now effectively have a direct line — able to coordinate and call each other whenever needed. The official purpose of the CIA director's visit to Moscow hasn't been announced yet.
